QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_19

question.text: SEBI's current prudential norms cap a Category III AIF's leverage at:

answer.text: 0.5 times the NAV of the fund
5 times the NAV of the fund
2 times the NAV of the fund

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 9.5 Point 12: Cat III AIF is permitted leverage up to 2 times the NAV as per SEBI prudential norms. Breach is reportable monthly. **The Trap:** Option A is too restrictive. Option B is wrong — leverage IS permitted. Option C would violate SEBI norms. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-B covers leverage cap; III-A/C (Compliance) covers reporting. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Set an internal soft-limit at 1.75x so you have operational buffer. Reporting breaches to SEBI within the stipulated window is non-negotiable — automate this trigger in your risk system.
